AigcChatCompletionStream.description_en: Calls a published Creative Agent with support for Lite and Dedicated editions, and returns execution progress and image artifacts by using Server-Sent Events (SSE). The Lite edition performs text-to-image or image-to-image generation depending on whether a reference image is provided. The Dedicated edition uses a Planner to plan and execute generation and editing tasks with multi-turn conversation support. Pass generation count, dimensions, and other parameters through metadata.parameters. Image URLs are included in the artifacts of the result
AigcChatCompletionStream.description_zh: 调用已发布的 Creative Agent，支持轻量版和专属版，以 SSE 返回执行进度和图片制品。轻量版根据是否提供参考图执行文生图或图生图；专属版通过 Planner 规划并执行生成、编辑任务，支持多轮会话。生成数量、尺寸等通过 metadata.parameters 传入，结果中的图片地址见 artifacts

GuiChatCompletionStream.description_en: Calls a published Mobile-Use Agent, supporting both Standard Edition and Dedicated Edition. Submits task text and the current screenshot, passes device and application context through metadata, and returns the next mobile UI operation via SSE. The caller executes the UI operation, then continues calling with the session ID and the latest screenshot
GuiChatCompletionStream.description_zh: 调用已发布的 Mobile-Use Agent，支持标准版和专属版。提交任务文本和当前屏幕截图，通过 metadata 传入设备与应用上下文，以 SSE 返回下一步手机界面操作。界面操作由调用方执行，执行后携带会话 ID 和最新截图继续调用

PaChatCompletionStream.description_en: Invokes a published Mobile Planner Agent using OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions messages to initiate a conversation or node planning, and returns text, model-provided reasoning content, and structured tool calling via SSE. Supports multi-turn sessions and model-supported image input. Business tools are executed by the caller
PaChatCompletionStream.description_zh: 调用已发布的 Mobile Planner Agent，使用 OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions 消息发起对话或任务规划，以 SSE 返回文本、模型提供的思考内容及结构化工具调用。支持多轮会话和模型支持的图片输入；业务工具由调用方执行
